reasons: Lake identity verifies Florida v. Bostick as U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1991-06-20, year 1991.
Lake citations verify official citation 501 U.S. 429 and the listed parallel/vendor citations.

defect.evidence_quote: In such a situation, the appropriate inquiry is whether a reasonable person would feel free to decline the officers' requests or otherwise terminate the encounter.
defect.problem: The holding field is truncated with an ellipsis and frames the bus point too broadly. The supported rule is not simply 'on a bus'; it applies when movement is restricted by a factor independent of police conduct, with the inquiry whether the person felt free to decline requests or terminate the encounter.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace the holding with: When movement is restricted by an independent factor, such as being a passenger on a bus scheduled to depart, the seizure inquiry is whether a reasonable person would feel free to decline the officers' requests or otherwise terminate the encounter.

reasons: The opinion says Bostick's freedom of movement was restricted by an independent factor, i.e. being a passenger on a bus.
The opinion remanded for application of the corrected totality standard and did not decide categorically whether a seizure occurred.
residual_risks: If the ellipsis is only a display teaser, the substantive page body cures it; as a holding field, it remains incomplete.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Tie the rule to independently constrained movement and complete the free-to-decline-or-terminate formulation.

defect.evidence_quote: That rule applies to encounters that take place on a city street or in an airport lobby, and it applies equally to encounters on a bus.
defect.problem: The disclosed evidence does not support assigning Bostick to the Knock and Talk home as 'Key — Progeny / Refinement.' The opinion concerns bus-sweep encounters and the disclosed lake record contains no home-role judgment or progeny application to knock-and-talk doctrine.
defect.proposed_fix: Remove or downgrade the Knock and Talk home-role unless a disclosed Knock and Talk authority note or progeny case applying Bostick to knock-and-talk encounters is added.

reasons: No disclosed majority holding applies Bostick to homes, doors, or knock-and-talk encounters.
The only home-related language located is in a dissent/lower-court quotation, not an affirmative Bostick holding or home-role judgment.
residual_risks: External or undisclosed knock-and-talk progeny may justify the role, but it is not verifiable from this record.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use a supported role only if the corpus discloses the bridge from Bostick's consensual-encounter test to knock-and-talk doctrine.

reasons: Recorded treatment fields match the lake treatment judgment: good_law, as_of_content 1991-06-20, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, migration-seed basis, no point overrides.
residual_risks: Treatment/currency substance is outside lens A and should be reviewed by lens B.

reasons: The authority-weight label is supported by the lake identity fields showing court_level scotus and court U.S. Supreme Court.
The page label 'Binding — SCOTUS' matches the asserted weight label.
residual_risks: No treatment/currency finding made under lens A.
